[[Viper probe droid/Legends|Viper probe droids]] were equipped with '''planetary sensor arrays'''. The array included numerous [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]] for [[Scout/Legends|scouting]] [[Planet/Legends|planets]] including ones capable of detecting lifeforms, energy sources and signs of habitation.<ref name="CFTD">''[[Cynabar's Fantastic Technology: Droids]]''</ref>
